{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display basic info: shape, first few rows, unique values, missing values, duplicates
print('Shape:', df.shape)
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

print('\nUnique values in channel:')
print(df['channel'].unique())

print('\nUnique values in converted:')
print(df['converted'].unique())

print('\nMissing values:')
print(df.isnull().sum())

print('\nDuplicate rows:', df.duplicated().sum())

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
conversion_rates = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rates by channel:')
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']
print(f'\nDifference (email - paid_search): {difference}')

# Print the final value explicitly
print(f'\nFinal value: {difference}')"}
